https://mastodon.social/@aarbrk@mstdn.mx.text: “The Comic Book Story of Video Games” by Jonathan Hennessey & Jack McGowan (2017). An exhaustive story starting in the 19th century, emphasizing economics and the effects of WWII and the Cold War. Narration dominates, with almost no dialogue between the many male figures from the US and Japan. Jumps around time and space create several continuity problems. 3pp of notes. Apparently #18 in a series of graphic history reviews. #videogames #usa #japan #history #histodons #comic #graphicnovel #book

https://mastodon.social/@schamspeare@mst.text: Well, I went 4 and 1 today, but it felt like it required a rather significant amount of concentration and nothing came easily. The whole experience today was kind of un-game-like in an odd way. I guess that's because you're basically parsing text that tells you how to do arithmetic. (And lord, what a lot of text!)
